newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia shares have good turnover, Unibanka gains.
newsitem.headline: Latvia shares have good turnover, Unibanka gains.

text.p: Shares on the Latvian stock market were well-traded on Tuesday and leading stock Unibanka made a small gain, the stock exchange said.
Overall turnover came to 134,467 lats and Unibanka made up 36,645 lats of the total trade. Its shares rose to 2.10 lats from 2.07 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, also on the official ist, turned over 23,700 lats of stock and was stable at one lat.
On the secondary market, the Daugavpils chain manufacturer was again the most traded on business of 41,701 lats although its shares slipped to 1.15 lats from 1.25.
Other active stocks on the secondary market were the Roja fish cannery on 16,008 lats and it leapt to 1.38 lats from 1.20 lats.
The rest of the secondary market was less well traded.
The Rigas Raugs yeast plant turned over 4,253 lats of stock as it rose to 1.85 lats from 1.75 lats and the Lode brick factory traded 5,008 lats for a rise of just over one percent to one lat.
